note: Retroactive partial isolation (honest caveat): this candidate set was declared AFTER earlier evaluation rounds already ran against these cases (W-series eval reports and the 10-case Recall/Precision runs recorded in CLAUDE.md). Holdout metrics computed on them must therefore be labelled 'retroactive holdout candidates' — they do not constitute a clean prospective holdout. A clean split requires case ids that no earlier round ever saw. Status transitions: candidate -> active (frozen for future eval only) or released (returned to the training pool).
